Equipment Enhancement has been unlocked.
Press the button to check out the menu.
Press Inventory.

You can now enhance equipment.
Select an equipped piece of equipment.

Select the equipment to enhance, and add the required enhancement materials.
Press this button.

Press the Select button to add the enhancement material.

After adding the materials, press the Enhance button.

The basic stats of the equipment increase based on the enhancement level.
Also, equipment is not destroyed at low enhancement levels.
You can enhance multiple pieces of equipment at once with this button.
Select the equipment again to cancel enhancement.
You can upgrade your character by selecting and enhancing the desired equipment.
